name: MatBench
description: A benchmark suite of materials science datasets and tasks for evaluating machine-learning methods, including prediction of materials properties and structures. This record describes the upstream benchmark and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Dunn, A., Wang, Q., Ganose, A., Dopp, D., & Jain, A. (2020). Benchmarking materials property prediction methods: the Matbench test set and Automatminer reference algorithm. npj Computational Materials, 6, 138. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41524-020-00406-3

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: MatBench is a benchmark suite comprising datasets from multiple sources; a single standard SPDX license identifier is not specified for the entire suite. Review the terms for each constituent dataset and its source before use or redistribution. This record is loader-only and vendors no data.
